secondary.name: The R Graph Gallery chart vocabulary

taxonomySource.note: Top-level groups are designed for data recovery: calibration family plus visible mark plus scientific semantics. R Graph Gallery is vocabulary input, not the product hierarchy.

groups.label: Polar & radial
groups.title: 极坐标、径向与圆记录图

groups.label: Map & scaled image
groups.title: 地图、显微图与标尺图像

groups.label: Composite figures
groups.title: 复合图、多面板与嵌入表

calibrationFamilies.label: 2D XY
calibrationFamilies.description: 线性、对数或日期轴；承载曲线、散点、直方图与大多数统计图。

calibrationFamilies.label: Bar axis
calibrationFamilies.description: 一个分类轴和一个连续轴；与两个连续轴的直方图分开。

calibrationFamilies.label: Polar
calibrationFamilies.description: 中心、径向标尺和角度方向的专用校准。

calibrationFamilies.label: Ternary
calibrationFamilies.description: 三角形三个顶点和方向决定三分量坐标。

calibrationFamilies.label: Map / scale bar
calibrationFamilies.description: 地图、显微图等只有比例尺的图像。

calibrationFamilies.label: Image pixels
calibrationFamilies.description: 不换算数据轴，直接恢复像素位置、距离、面积或周长。

calibrationFamilies.label: Circular recorder
calibrationFamilies.description: 圆形记录纸的时间与径向信号专用校准。

calibrationFamilies.label: Structure parser
calibrationFamilies.description: 节点、边、扇区、层级和流带，不强行套用 XY 坐标。

calibrationFamilies.label: Scientific router
calibrationFamilies.description: 识别科研语义和面板结构，再路由到一个或多个校准/图元提取器。

capabilities.label: Line / time series
capabilities.recoverableRepresentation: 颜色可分的曲线中心线与校准坐标
capabilities.nonRecoverable: 不可见采样点、平滑参数与插值规则

capabilities.label: Step curve
capabilities.recoverableRepresentation: 水平段、垂直跃迁和转折坐标
capabilities.nonRecoverable: 隐藏的作者原始数据与不可见统计过程

capabilities.label: Connected trajectory
capabilities.recoverableRepresentation: 有序点或连续路径
capabilities.nonRecoverable: 隐藏的作者原始数据与不可见统计过程

capabilities.label: Area / stacked area
capabilities.recoverableRepresentation: 基线和每层可见上边界
capabilities.nonRecoverable: 被遮挡层边界与原始样本

capabilities.label: Dose-response / fitted model
capabilities.recoverableRepresentation: 可见模型曲线、拐点与标定轴
capabilities.nonRecoverable: 作者未公开的拟合过程与残差

capabilities.label: Waveform / signal trace
capabilities.recoverableRepresentation: 时间-幅值轨迹、事件边界与标尺
capabilities.nonRecoverable: 隐藏采样率、滤波与触发条件

capabilities.label: Scatter
capabilities.recoverableRepresentation: 点中心、系列与校准坐标
capabilities.nonRecoverable: 隐藏的作者原始数据与不可见统计过程

capabilities.label: Bubble
capabilities.recoverableRepresentation: 点中心；有尺寸图例时估计面积编码
capabilities.nonRecoverable: 没有图例时面积对应的绝对值

capabilities.label: Dense scatter / marginal
capabilities.recoverableRepresentation: 可分离点、密度轮廓与边际统计图
capabilities.nonRecoverable: 融合点簇中的逐点身份

capabilities.label: Connected scatter
capabilities.recoverableRepresentation: 点中心、连接顺序与分组
capabilities.nonRecoverable: 隐藏的作者原始数据与不可见统计过程

capabilities.label: Regression scatter
capabilities.recoverableRepresentation: 点、拟合线和可见参考线分层恢复
capabilities.nonRecoverable: 作者模型的未公开参数与推断过程

capabilities.label: Volcano / Manhattan
capabilities.recoverableRepresentation: 点中心、阈值线、显著点标签和轴变换
capabilities.nonRecoverable: 隐藏的作者原始数据与不可见统计过程

capabilities.label: Embedding / UMAP / t-SNE
capabilities.recoverableRepresentation: 可见点位置、类别、聚类和局部轨迹
capabilities.nonRecoverable: 高维原始特征与真实距离语义

capabilities.label: Vertical / horizontal bar
capabilities.recoverableRepresentation: 分类、系列、基线与柱端值
capabilities.nonRecoverable: 隐藏的作者原始数据与不可见统计过程

capabilities.label: Grouped bar
capabilities.recoverableRepresentation: 组、子系列和各柱端值
capabilities.nonRecoverable: 隐藏的作者原始数据与不可见统计过程

capabilities.label: Stacked / 100% bar
capabilities.recoverableRepresentation: 每个可见分段边界与合计
capabilities.nonRecoverable: 未展示的组内样本

capabilities.label: Diverging bar
capabilities.recoverableRepresentation: 零基线两侧的类别和端值
capabilities.nonRecoverable: 隐藏的作者原始数据与不可见统计过程

capabilities.label: Waterfall
capabilities.recoverableRepresentation: 起点、增量、累计端点和连接线
capabilities.nonRecoverable: 隐藏的作者原始数据与不可见统计过程

capabilities.label: Lollipop / dot plot
capabilities.recoverableRepresentation: 类别位置、点值与连接线
capabilities.nonRecoverable: 隐藏的作者原始数据与不可见统计过程

capabilities.label: Histogram
capabilities.recoverableRepresentation: 连续轴下的 bin 边界与高度
capabilities.nonRecoverable: 生成直方图的原始样本

capabilities.label: Boxplot
capabilities.recoverableRepresentation: 五数概括与可见离群点
capabilities.nonRecoverable: 原始样本

capabilities.label: Violin / raincloud
capabilities.recoverableRepresentation: 可见密度轮廓、内嵌箱线和样本点
capabilities.nonRecoverable: 核密度参数与原始样本

capabilities.label: Strip / beeswarm
capabilities.recoverableRepresentation: 可分离点中心、组别和局部堆叠
capabilities.nonRecoverable: 融合点簇中的隐藏样本

capabilities.label: Density / ridgeline
capabilities.recoverableRepresentation: 每组可见密度轮廓
capabilities.nonRecoverable: 生成曲线的原始样本和带宽

capabilities.label: ECDF / cumulative
capabilities.recoverableRepresentation: 阶梯位置与可见累计概率
capabilities.nonRecoverable: 重复值中的精确个体身份

capabilities.label: Error bar / point range
capabilities.recoverableRepresentation: 点估计、上下端点和帽线，独立于主系列
capabilities.nonRecoverable: 未说明的 SD、SEM 或置信区间语义

capabilities.label: Forest / coefficient
capabilities.recoverableRepresentation: 点估计、区间端点、参考线和行标签
capabilities.nonRecoverable: 作者未展示的统计模型

capabilities.label: Confidence / ribbon band
capabilities.recoverableRepresentation: 上下边界和中心线
capabilities.nonRecoverable: 误差带定义与原始拟合样本

capabilities.label: Funnel plot
capabilities.recoverableRepresentation: 研究点、中心线与显著性边界
capabilities.nonRecoverable: 隐藏的作者原始数据与不可见统计过程

capabilities.label: Candlestick / OHLC
capabilities.recoverableRepresentation: 开高低收与时间位置
capabilities.nonRecoverable: 隐藏的作者原始数据与不可见统计过程

capabilities.label: Heatmap
capabilities.recoverableRepresentation: 行列网格、经色条标定的单元值与可见显著性标记
capabilities.nonRecoverable: 无色条时的绝对数值，以及色条端点之外被截断的精确幅度

capabilities.label: Correlogram / dot matrix
capabilities.recoverableRepresentation: 矩阵索引、符号与可标定颜色/面积
capabilities.nonRecoverable: 隐藏的作者原始数据与不可见统计过程

capabilities.label: Contour / isoline
capabilities.recoverableRepresentation: 等值线几何、标签和标定坐标
capabilities.nonRecoverable: 线间未显示的连续场

capabilities.label: 2D density
capabilities.recoverableRepresentation: 色条标定的密度场和可见轮廓
capabilities.nonRecoverable: 原始二维事件全集

capabilities.label: Raster / intensity field
capabilities.recoverableRepresentation: 规则像元与经色条标定的强度
capabilities.nonRecoverable: 插值前的原始测量点

capabilities.label: 3D surface / mesh
capabilities.recoverableRepresentation: 可见投影轮廓和网格交点
capabilities.nonRecoverable: 单张透视图遮挡的背面与真实三维网格

capabilities.label: Polar curve / scatter
capabilities.recoverableRepresentation: 角度、半径和系列轨迹
capabilities.nonRecoverable: 隐藏的作者原始数据与不可见统计过程

capabilities.label: Radar / spider
capabilities.recoverableRepresentation: 逐轴半径值和系列多边形
capabilities.nonRecoverable: 隐藏的作者原始数据与不可见统计过程

capabilities.label: Rose / wind rose
capabilities.recoverableRepresentation: 角度 bin、径向长度和堆叠分段
capabilities.nonRecoverable: 隐藏的作者原始数据与不可见统计过程

capabilities.label: Circular bar
capabilities.recoverableRepresentation: 角度类别和径向柱长
capabilities.nonRecoverable: 隐藏的作者原始数据与不可见统计过程

capabilities.label: Radial heatmap
capabilities.recoverableRepresentation: 角度-半径网格与颜色值
capabilities.nonRecoverable: 隐藏的作者原始数据与不可见统计过程

capabilities.label: Circular chart recorder
capabilities.recoverableRepresentation: 圆周时间和径向信号轨迹
capabilities.nonRecoverable: 记录纸转速与起始时间未标注时的绝对时间

capabilities.label: Ternary scatter
capabilities.recoverableRepresentation: 三角坐标内点与三分量比例
capabilities.nonRecoverable: 隐藏的作者原始数据与不可见统计过程

capabilities.label: Ternary contour / heatmap
capabilities.recoverableRepresentation: 三元网格、等值线与颜色值
capabilities.nonRecoverable: 隐藏的作者原始数据与不可见统计过程

capabilities.label: Simplex trajectory
capabilities.recoverableRepresentation: 三分量点序列和连接方向
capabilities.nonRecoverable: 隐藏的作者原始数据与不可见统计过程

capabilities.label: Raster / choropleth map
capabilities.recoverableRepresentation: 有地理配准和色条时的像元或区域值
capabilities.nonRecoverable: 缺失投影时的精确地理坐标

capabilities.label: Point / bubble map
capabilities.recoverableRepresentation: 点位置、类别与可标定面积
capabilities.nonRecoverable: 隐藏的作者原始数据与不可见统计过程

capabilities.label: Grid / hexbin map
capabilities.recoverableRepresentation: 网格索引、边界和颜色值
capabilities.nonRecoverable: 隐藏的作者原始数据与不可见统计过程

capabilities.label: Connection map
capabilities.recoverableRepresentation: 可见端点、路径和方向
capabilities.nonRecoverable: 隐藏的作者原始数据与不可见统计过程

capabilities.label: Cartogram
capabilities.recoverableRepresentation: 变形后的区域、标签和邻接
capabilities.nonRecoverable: 未提供底图时的原始地理面积

capabilities.label: Scale-bar image / microscopy
capabilities.recoverableRepresentation: 比例尺标定后的点、距离、面积和对象轮廓
capabilities.nonRecoverable: 隐藏的作者原始数据与不可见统计过程

capabilities.label: Generic pixel measurement
capabilities.recoverableRepresentation: 像素位置、轮廓、距离、面积与周长
capabilities.nonRecoverable: 没有比例尺时的物理单位

capabilities.label: Pie / donut
capabilities.recoverableRepresentation: 双遍转录一致的可见百分比标签；扇区角度仅作独立验证
capabilities.nonRecoverable: 隐藏的作者原始数据与不可见统计过程

capabilities.label: Treemap / Voronoi treemap
capabilities.recoverableRepresentation: 可见区域面积、标签与显式层级
capabilities.nonRecoverable: 未编码或被裁切的隐藏层级

capabilities.label: Sunburst / circle packing
capabilities.recoverableRepresentation: 可见嵌套、面积或角度
capabilities.nonRecoverable: 隐藏的作者原始数据与不可见统计过程

capabilities.label: Dendrogram
capabilities.recoverableRepresentation: 可见叶、分支与合并高度
capabilities.nonRecoverable: 生成树的原始距离矩阵

capabilities.label: Waffle / unit grid
capabilities.recoverableRepresentation: 单位格计数、类别和显式比例
capabilities.nonRecoverable: 隐藏的作者原始数据与不可见统计过程

capabilities.label: Sankey / alluvial
capabilities.recoverableRepresentation: 节点、层级、可见流带宽度和标签
capabilities.nonRecoverable: 遮挡流与未标定流量

capabilities.label: Network
capabilities.recoverableRepresentation: 可见节点、边、标签和布局坐标
capabilities.nonRecoverable: 遮挡边和隐藏拓扑

capabilities.label: Chord / Circos
capabilities.recoverableRepresentation: 扇区、连接带、方向和环形注释
capabilities.nonRecoverable: 隐藏的作者原始数据与不可见统计过程

capabilities.label: Arc / edge bundling
capabilities.recoverableRepresentation: 可分离节点和可见路径
capabilities.nonRecoverable: 捆绑重叠中的完整边集合

capabilities.label: Phylogenetic tree
capabilities.recoverableRepresentation: 分支拓扑、叶标签、分支长度和旁注轨道
capabilities.nonRecoverable: 生成树的序列比对和模型

capabilities.label: Kaplan–Meier + risk table
capabilities.recoverableRepresentation: 阶梯曲线、删失标记、风险表和组别
capabilities.nonRecoverable: 个体级生存记录

capabilities.label: ROC / precision-recall
capabilities.recoverableRepresentation: 多系列阶梯曲线、参考线和阈值路径
capabilities.nonRecoverable: 逐样本预测分数与精确阈值

capabilities.label: Mass spectrum / stick spectrum
capabilities.recoverableRepresentation: 峰位、相对强度、基线和可读峰标注
capabilities.nonRecoverable: 仪器原始谱、峰宽和未显示低强度信号

capabilities.label: Spectrum / chromatogram
capabilities.recoverableRepresentation: 连续曲线、峰位、峰高/面积和标注
capabilities.nonRecoverable: 仪器响应函数和原始采样

capabilities.label: Flow cytometry gating
capabilities.recoverableRepresentation: 二维密度场、门控多边形、簇中心和比例标注
capabilities.nonRecoverable: FCS 事件级数据与补偿矩阵

capabilities.label: Gel / blot densitometry
capabilities.recoverableRepresentation: 泳道、条带轮廓、背景校正后的相对灰度
capabilities.nonRecoverable: 饱和像素对应的真实信号

capabilities.label: Genome / sequence tracks
capabilities.recoverableRepresentation: 共享坐标下的峰、区间、基因模型和标签
capabilities.nonRecoverable: 未显示 reads 和碱基级原始数据

capabilities.label: Spatial omics / tissue embedding
capabilities.recoverableRepresentation: 组织坐标、点类别、强度和区域边界
capabilities.nonRecoverable: 表达矩阵与原始组织影像配准参数

capabilities.label: Multi-panel routing
capabilities.recoverableRepresentation: 面板边界、类型路由和逐面板证据状态
capabilities.nonRecoverable: 未处理面板的数值

capabilities.label: Small multiples / facet
capabilities.recoverableRepresentation: 重复坐标系、面板变量、共享图例与逐面板图元
capabilities.nonRecoverable: 隐藏的作者原始数据与不可见统计过程

capabilities.label: Inset / zoom panel
capabilities.recoverableRepresentation: 主图与插图边界、连接框和各自坐标系
capabilities.nonRecoverable: 隐藏的作者原始数据与不可见统计过程

capabilities.label: Dual-axis / mixed scale
capabilities.recoverableRepresentation: 系列到坐标轴的归属和两套校准
capabilities.nonRecoverable: 隐藏的作者原始数据与不可见统计过程

capabilities.label: Broken / discontinuous axis
capabilities.recoverableRepresentation: 每个连续区间的独立校准与拼接规则
capabilities.nonRecoverable: 隐藏的作者原始数据与不可见统计过程

capabilities.label: Marginal plot
capabilities.recoverableRepresentation: 中心 XY 图与共享轴边际统计图
capabilities.nonRecoverable: 隐藏的作者原始数据与不可见统计过程

capabilities.label: Chart + table / mixed overlay
capabilities.recoverableRepresentation: 图层分解、表格 OCR、共享类别和系列归属
capabilities.nonRecoverable: 图例没有说明时的隐式语义

engine.stable: 已有专用稳定提取器与回归测试
engine.candidate: 已有可执行路线或局部实现，尚未通过完整晋级门槛
engine.benchmark_only: 仅有确定性基准路线，不是稳定用户功能
engine.coordinate_specific: 需要该坐标/拓扑专用解析器，不能套用普通 XY 校准
engine.restricted: 只能恢复明确的可见表示，不能声称还原隐藏原始数据

demo.oa_reference: 真实 OA 案例已定位，等待专用验证
